name: source-and-runtime-integrity
script:
set -e; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
root=Path("/candidate"); digest=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
paths=["src/mtc_task_cpp", "src/mtc_manipulation_cpp", "src/mtc_motion_execution_cpp", "src/mtc_core_cpp", "src/mtc_interfaces", "src/mtc_ros2_action_cpp/include/mtc_ros2_action_cpp/action_slot.hpp"]
for p in paths:
 assert not subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(root),"diff","HEAD","--",p]),p
iface=subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(root),"diff","1d940f7c5f12561fed6641457c0b4b630a282b05","HEAD","--","src/mtc_interfaces"])
assert not iface
actual=[]
for p in Path("/integration-build/mtc_ros2_action_cpp/test_results").rglob("*.xml"):
 t=ET.parse(p).getroot()
 actual.append({"path":str(p),"tests":len(t.findall(".//testcase")),"failures":len(t.findall(".//failure")),"errors":len(t.findall(".//error")),"sha256":digest(p)})
cpp={str(p.relative_to(root)):digest(p) for p in (root/"src/mtc_ros2_action_cpp").rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
ui={str(p.relative_to(root)):digest(p) for p in (root/"src/mtc_cpp_mock_bringup").rglob("*") if p.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in str(p)}
result={"core_files_unchanged":paths,"interfaces_unchanged_since_formal_pin":True,"cpp_action_xml":actual,"cpp_source_sha256":cpp,"ui_source_sha256":ui}
Path("/integration-evidence/source-integrity.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if "sha256" not in k},indent=2))
PY
argv:
source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; source /candidate-install/setup.bash; if [ -f /integration-install/setup.bash ]; then source /integration-install/setup.bash; fi; unset ROS_STATIC_PEERS ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE FASTDDS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE CYCLONEDDS_URI; export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=161 RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_fastrtps_cpp ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE=LOCALHOST PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ROS_LOG_DIR=/integration-evidence/roslogs; set -e; python3 - <<'PY'
